name: prioritization-formula
description: Score and rank competing work with the prioritization formula: value over effort times confidence, with the arithmetic shown. Stack-rank backlogs, decide what to build first.

interface.longDescription: Scores and stack-ranks competing features, projects, or initiatives with one formula, value over effort times confidence, and shows the arithmetic for every row so the ranking can be argued with. The Sniff Test readout challenges scores that look inflated, especially when the person submitting them benefits. Use it when deciding what to build or do first, comparing work across teams, or before building a roadmap. Built from the Prioritization Formula playbook at andrewluxem.com. Static skill: no network calls.
capabilities: Scored, stack-ranked backlogs with arithmetic shown
Sniff tests that challenge suspicious scores
Decide what to build or do first
